title: Free ATS Resume Builder [2026 Templates] | ZenResume
excerpt: Build a free ATS resume in minutes. Use our 2026 tech templates and AI to pass resume scanners. Instantly download your PDF—no hidden fees.
content_html:
🌿 100% Free & No Account Needed

Create an ATS-Friendly Resume in 5 Minutes

Build a recruiter-approved professional resume. Your details stay 100% private in your browser local cache—never saved to a server database.

Why Build With ZenResume?

Magic AI Import

Upload a messy resume PDF or copy-paste raw text. Our integrated Gemini AI automatically parses and pre-fills your layout fields in seconds.

100% Data Privacy

No account signups, no data tracking. Your personal details remain locally saved in your browser storage. Download and load backup JSONs anytime.

ATS-Optimized Templates

Choose from 7 recruiter-approved templates structured specifically for resume parsing software, ensuring your applications actually get read.

High-Fidelity PDF Prints

Utilizes native CSS print compilation to compile sharp, selectable-text vector PDFs. Recruiter software can easily index your skills.

How It Works

1

Choose Layout

Select from 7 industry-approved templates categorized by experience levels and disciplines.

2

Fill Details

Use our step-by-step form wizard or let Gemini AI parse your inputs automatically.

3

Download PDF

Preview in real-time and export a high-fidelity vector PDF to your system instantly.

Latest Career Resources

Expert advice on resume writing, passing ATS systems, and landing your dream job.

View All Articles →

Contact & Profiles

Provide your contact details. Keep titles clear and emails professional.

Professional Summary

Write a concise, 3-4 sentence paragraph highlighting your core capabilities, technical goals, and credentials.

Skills & Keywords

List your technical skills and domain expertise. Separating them with commas makes it easy for the ATS to parse.

Work Experience

Detail your recent professional history, internships, or leadership positions.

Technical Projects

List key academic capstone works, personal engineering repositories, or major prototypes built.

Education

Add your formal degrees, universities, graduation timelines, and grade credentials.

Certifications

Add professional licensing, training courses, and verified developer badges to strengthen your profile.
